First stable release of PKTool: a Pokémon save editor that runs on the Nintendo DS itself.

**Download `PKTool.nds` below**, copy it to your flashcart's SD card and start it from the flashcart menu. PKTool finds the Pokémon `.sav` files on the card; everything it writes is backed up first in `/PKTOOL/backups`.

## What it does

- **Games:** Red/Blue/Yellow, Gold/Silver/Crystal, Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald, FireRed/LeafGreen, Diamond/Pearl/Platinum, HeartGold/SoulSilver and Black/White 1-2.
- **Edit** any Pokémon (species, level, nature, ability, moves, IVs/EVs or DVs/Stat Exp, item, ball, original trainer, met data, Pokérus, ribbons), the trainer card and the bag.
- **Create** Pokémon, import Showdown sets, receive Wonder Cards and event Pokémon, hatch Day-Care eggs.
- **Check legality** with a report on every Pokémon, and **LEGALIZE** with one button: it gives the Pokémon a real encounter of its game and tells you what is impossible.
- **Bank** on the SD card shared by all your saves, with box names, search and sorting; move Pokémon between games the official ways (Pal Park, Poké Transfer, Time Capsule).
- Japanese and Korean text, name languages (ja, fr, it, de, es, ko), touch screen and an on-screen keyboard.

## Known limits

- Gen I/II saves were tested with synthetic saves only, not with real ones.
- Tested on real hardware (a DS with an R4 flashcart); other flashcarts and loaders are untested.
